sources.seasonal_homes: ACS B25004_006 (vacant: seasonal, recreational or occasional use) via data/hna/vacancy-status.json

meta.method: Seasonal homes are ACS vacant units held for seasonal, recreational or occasional use; the Census counts a second home here when nobody lives in it most of the year. Share is that count divided by all housing units, with the ACS proportion margin of error. Reliability is the count's coefficient of variation: up to 15% reliable, up to 30% use with caution, above that unreliable. Short-term rental license counts are a different universe and date from ACS and are not added to it.

county_ballot_measures.title: County lodging tax increase from 2% to 3% with 45% of proceeds for workforce housing and childcare
county_ballot_measures.detail: Raises the county lodging tax on short-term stays from 2% to 3%, stated as $84,494.00 annually commencing January 1, 2027. Total proceeds would be allocated 40% to tourism marketing, 45% to housing and childcare for the tourism-related workforce and other workers, and 15% to visitor-experience uses.
